records.title: Left ankle permanent and stationary evaluation
records.summary: The report reviews a left trimalleolar ankle fracture sustained at work on September 30, 2024, followed by open reduction and internal fixation on October 2, 2024. After 15 physical therapy visits, the patient continued to report stiffness, swelling, and limitations in some recreational activities. Examination documented a healed medial scar, moderate swelling, plantarflexion of 62 degrees, and dorsiflexion of 4 degrees. The physician deemed the patient at maximum medical improvement and permanent and stationary on December 29, 2025, with full-duty work capacity. The report assigned 7% left lower-extremity impairment and 3% whole-person impairment, apportioned entirely to the industrial injury. Future care listed treating-physician visits, podiatry follow-up, and hardware removal as needed.
